lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Alas-singko y media ng umaga sa {hometown}. Amoy mainit na pandesal at 3-in-1 coffee. Nakasampay na ang bagong plantsang uniform mo para sa unang araw ng Senior High School — {strand} strand.
lines.textEn: 5:30 AM in {hometown}. The scent of warm pandesal and 3-in-1 coffee fills the house. Your freshly ironed uniform hangs ready for Day 1 of Senior High School — {strand} strand.

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Gising na, {name}! Kumain ka muna ng sinangag bago ka umalis. Eto pala ang baon mo — pasensya na kung barya-barya muna, anak.
lines.textEn: Wake up, {name}! Eat some garlic rice before leaving. Here is your allowance — sorry if it is mostly coins for now.

lines.speaker: {name}
lines.text: Okay lang po, Ma! Barya lang 'to ngayon, pero balang araw diploma ang kapalit nito.
lines.textEn: It is totally fine, Ma! Just loose coins today, but one day this turns into a diploma.

choices.text: Magmano at yakapin si Mama bago umalis.
choices.textEn: Do mano and hug Mama before heading out.

journal.title: Unang Araw ng SHS
journal.summary: Nagsimula ang laban mo sa Grade 11 ({strand}) dala ang basbas ni Mama at barya sa bulsa.
journal.summaryEn: Started Grade 11 ({strand}) with Mama's blessing and a handful of coins.

choices.text: Mag-baon ng extra kanin at itlog para tipid sa canteen.
choices.textEn: Pack extra rice and boiled egg to save lunch money.

journal.title: Tipid Baon Strategy
journal.summary: Unang araw pa lang, nag-baon ka na ng kanin at itlog para makatipid.
journal.summaryEn: Day one and you already packed rice and egg to stretch your budget.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Siksikan sa jeep! May karatula sa harap: 'BARYA LANG PO SA UMAGA'. Pagtingin mo sa bulsa, isang lukot na ₱100 bill at dalawang piso lang ang nadampot mo.
lines.textEn: Packed morning jeepney! A sign hangs up front: 'EXACT COINS ONLY IN THE MORNING.' You reach into your pocket and find a crumpled ₱100 bill and two peso coins.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Uy, {strand} ka rin?! Same uniform patch! Wait — ₱100 ibabayad mo kay Manong? Mapapagalitan ka niyan! Akin na, palitan ko ng barya. Ako si Miggy nga pala!
lines.textEn: Hey, you are in {strand} too?! Same patch! Wait — paying ₱100 to the driver? He will roast you! Here, let me break it into coins. I am Miggy by the way!

choices.text: Salamat bro! Sabay na tayo pumasok sa gate.
choices.textEn: Thanks! Let us walk to the school gate together.

choices.text: Bayaran mo muna pamasahe niya bilang pasasalamat (-₱26 total).
choices.textEn: Cover his fare too as a thank you (-₱26 total).

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Nakatayo ka sa tapat ng school gate habang nakawagayway ang watawat ng Pilipinas. Ang init na kahit 7AM pa lang.
lines.textEn: You stand before the school gate as the Philippine flag flutters overhead. Already sweltering at 7 AM.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Excuse me! Kayo ba sina {name} at Miggy? Section 1-{strand} tayo! Ako si Bea — dala ko na rin 'yung photocopy ng class schedule para hindi na kayo pumila.
lines.textEn: Excuse me! Are you {name} and Miggy? We are in Section 1-{strand}! I am Bea — I brought photocopies of our schedule so you do not have to queue.

choices.text: Bayaran ang ₱5 photocopy at purihin si Bea.
choices.textEn: Pay the ₱5 photocopy cost and thank Bea warmly.

choices.text: Picturan na lang sa phone — tipid mode muna!
choices.textEn: Just snap a photo on your phone — saving every peso!

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Good morning, Grade 11! Ako si Sir Reyes, ang adviser ninyo. Sa {strand}, hindi sapat ang talino — kailangan ng sipag, disiplina, at kumpletong yellow pad.
lines.textEn: Good morning, Grade 11! I am Sir Reyes, your adviser. In {strand}, brains are not enough — you need grit, discipline, and your own yellow pad.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Bago tayo magsimula, kailangan ng class beadle at magbibigay ng unang recitation. Sino ang magbo-volunteer?
lines.textEn: Before we begin, I need a class representative and our first recitation volunteer. Who is stepping up?

choices.text: Taas kamay agad! 'Sir, ready po ako!'
choices.textEn: Raise your hand immediately! 'Sir, I am ready!'

choices.text: Yuko nang bahagya at magsulat muna ng notes.
choices.textEn: Keep a low profile and take neat notes instead.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Recess time sa canteen! Puno ng amoy ng banana cue, turon, at mainit na pancit canton.
lines.textEn: Lunch break at the canteen! The air smells of caramelized banana cue, turon, and hot pancit canton.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Yo! Carlo pala, taga-student council at music org. Napansin ko kasama niyo si Bea — solid squad na kayo agad! Tara, hati-hati tayo sa malaking pancit at tig-iisa ng gulaman!
lines.textEn: Yo! I am Carlo from the student council and music org. Saw you hanging out with Bea — solid squad already! Let us split a big pancit tray and iced gulaman!

choices.text: G! Ambag ako ng ₱45 para sa barkada lunch!
choices.textEn: Count me in! Chip in ₱45 for barkada lunch!

choices.text: May baon ako eh, pero sasabay ako sa kwentuhan!
choices.textEn: I packed lunch, but I will sit and hang out with you guys!

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Anak, pasensya na ha... tumaas bigla ang bayarin sa kuryente at tubig ngayong buwan. Baka kalahati lang muna ang maibigay kong baon sa susunod na linggo.
lines.textEn: Sweetheart, I am so sorry... electric and water bills spiked this month. I might only manage half your usual allowance next week.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Nakita mo si Mama na paulit-ulit nagbibilang ng maliliit na barya sa lamesa habang hawak ang bill ng kuryente.
lines.textEn: You watch Mama recount small coins at the dining table beside the crumpled electric bill.

choices.text: 'Huwag ka mag-alala Ma, maghahanap ako ng part-time raket!'
choices.textEn: 'Do not worry Ma, I will find a part-time gig!'

choices.text: Ibigay ang ₱150 mula sa ipon mo para sa kuryente.
choices.textEn: Hand Mama ₱150 from your pocket for the bill.

choices.text: Tahimik lang na tanggapin — magtipid na lang sa school.
choices.textEn: Accept quietly — you will just cut corners at school.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Aling Nena! Eto na 'yung sinasabi ko — si {name}! Mabilis kumilos, magaling sa math, at hindi nangungupit ng lumpiang shanghai!
lines.textEn: Aling Nena! Here is {name} like I told you! Fast worker, good at math, and won't sneak extra lumpia!

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: O sige nga, iho/iha! Kailangan ko ng taga-serve tuwing rush hour. May sahod ka na, may libreng kanin at sabaw pa. Try mo na ngayon?
lines.textEn: Alright then! I need a helper during lunch rush. You get cash pay plus free rice and soup. Want to try a shift right now?

choices.text: Game po, Aling Nena! Mag-shift na ako ngayon! (Play Carinderia Rush)
choices.textEn: Count me in, Aling Nena! Let me start now! (Play Carinderia Rush)

choices.text: Salamat po! Babalik ako sa bakanteng schedule ko sa planner.
choices.textEn: Thank you! I will drop by during my free planner slots.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Midterm week na! Puno ang library at amoy kape at highlighter ang buong paligid.
lines.textEn: Midterm week is here! The library is packed with the scent of coffee and highlighters.

lines.speaker: Jamie
lines.text: Hi {name}... napansin kong puyat ka na. Eto, may extra SkyFlakes at 3-in-1 ako. Gusto mo sabay tayo mag-review ng formulas?
lines.textEn: Hi {name}... noticed you look exhausted. Here, I have extra crackers and coffee. Want to review formulas together?

choices.text: Oo naman, Jamie! Sabay tayo hanggang mag-close ang library.
choices.textEn: Yes please, Jamie! Let us study until the library closes.

choices.text: Isama natin sina Bea at Miggy para group review!
choices.textEn: Invite Bea and Miggy too for a full group review!

choices.text: Salamat Jamie, pero kailangan ko mag-overtime sa trabaho mamaya.
choices.textEn: Thanks Jamie, but I have to work an extra shift tonight.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Tapos na ang unang midterm exam ng Grade 11! Tandaan: ang GWA niyo dito ang pundasyon ng scholarship niyo sa kolehiyo.
lines.textEn: First Grade 11 midterms are done! Remember: your GWA here is the foundation for college scholarships.

choices.text: I-check ang test paper at mag-note ng mali para bumawi.
choices.textEn: Review your mistakes carefully to improve next time.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Guys, deadline na ng group portfolio bukas! ₱180 ang color print plus binding. Hindi pa nag-aambag si Kevin — seen lang sa group chat!
lines.textEn: Guys, the group portfolio is due tomorrow! Color printing and binding costs ₱180. Kevin still has not chipped in — just left us on seen!

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Classic freeloader! Paano na 'to, {name}? Hati-hati ba tayo o tanggalin na natin pangalan niya sa cover page?
lines.textEn: Classic freeloader! What do we do, {name}? Split the cost ourselves or drop his name from the cover page?

choices.text: Mag-ambag ng ₱90 at tanggalin ang freeloader sa cover page.
choices.textEn: Chip in ₱90 and remove the freeloader from the cover page.

choices.text: I-print na lang sa black-and-white (₱40) at pagandahin ang handwriting cover.
choices.textEn: Print in black-and-white (₱40) and craft a neat hand-drawn cover.

choices.text: Kausapin si Kevin nang maayos — baka wala lang din siyang pera.
choices.textEn: Talk to Kevin privately — maybe he is broke too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Tapos na ang 1st Semester Finals ng Grade 11! Sabay-sabay naghihiyawan ang buong klase paglabas ng room.
lines.textEn: Grade 11 1st Semester Finals are finally over! The whole class cheers as everyone pours out of the room.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: WOOH! Buhay pa tayo! Tara, fishball at kwek-kwek celebration sa kanto! Kahit ₱20 lang solve na!
lines.textEn: WOOH! We survived! Let us celebrate with fishballs and kwek-kwek at the corner! Even ₱20 hits the spot!

choices.text: Tara! Deserve natin ng kwek-kwek! (-₱35)
choices.textEn: Let us go! We earned those kwek-kwek! (-₱35)

choices.text: Pass muna ako, diretso uwi para magpahinga.
choices.textEn: I will pass and head straight home to recharge.

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: Welcome back sa 2nd Semester, {name}! Mas mabigat ang subjects ngayon — may Practical Research 1 na! Sumali ka ba sa club fair mamaya?
lines.textEn: Welcome back to 2nd Semester, {name}! Heavier subjects this term — Practical Research 1 starts now! Checking out the club fair later?

choices.text: Sumali sa student org ni Carlo para sa connections at leadership!
choices.textEn: Join Carlo's student org for leadership and connections!

choices.text: Mag-focus muna sa studies at part-time gigs.
choices.textEn: Stay focused on studies and part-time gigs for now.

lines.speaker: Miggy
lines.text: Psst, {name}! Ang daming estudyanteng laging nakakalimot ng yellow pad, ballpen, at naghahanap ng chichirya sa classroom. Magtinda kaya tayo ng school supplies at tusok-tusok pag uwian?
lines.textEn: Psst, {name}! Students always forget yellow pad and pens, and everyone craves snacks after class. Want to sell supplies and street snacks after dismissal?

choices.text: Magandang diskarte 'yan! Subukan natin! (Play Tusok-Tusok)
choices.textEn: Smart hustle! Let us try it! (Play Street Snacks)

choices.text: Baka mahuli ng guidance — stick na lang ako sa regular part-time.
choices.textEn: Might get caught by guidance — I will stick to regular part-time work.

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Midterms ng 2nd Semester! Malapit na matapos ang Grade 11. Sino dito ang nagbabalak mag-apply ng academic scholarship para sa kolehiyo?
lines.textEn: 2nd Semester Midterms! Grade 11 is almost over. Who here plans to apply for a college academic scholarship?

choices.text: Mag-all-nighter review para mahatak pataas ang GWA!
choices.textEn: Pull an all-nighter to boost your GWA!

choices.text: Balanced study + sapat na tulog para malinaw ang utak bukas.
choices.textEn: Balanced review plus proper sleep so your mind stays sharp.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Fiesta sa barangay! Puno ng makukulay na banderitas, tugtugan ng brass band, at amoy ng inihaw na liempo sa buong kalye.
lines.textEn: Barangay fiesta night! Colorful buntings crisscross the street while brass bands play and grilled pork smoke drifts overhead.

lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Kahit simple lang ang handa natin, {name}, imbitahin mo ang barkada mo! Minsan lang tayo makapag-pahinga sa gastusin.
lines.textEn: Even if our spread is simple, {name}, invite your friends over! It is rare we get to pause and breathe.

choices.text: Imbitahin ang buong barkada at si Jamie sa bahay!
choices.textEn: Invite the whole barkada and Jamie over!

choices.text: Tumulong muna sa food stall ng kapitbahay para kumita habang fiesta (+₱320).
choices.textEn: Help man the neighbor's barbecue stall during fiesta (+₱320).

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: Nagawa natin! Tapos na ang Grade 11! Isang taon na lang, kolehiyo na tayo!
lines.textEn: We did it! Grade 11 is done! One more year and we are off to college!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Bago mag-bakasyon, napatingin ka sa wallet mo at sa report card mo. Grade 12 na ang susunod — mas malapit na sa pangarap mong {course}.
lines.textEn: Before summer break, you glance at your wallet and report card. Grade 12 is next — one step closer to your dream {course} degree.

choices.text: Mag-summer raket para may ipon sa Grade 12 (+₱450, -Energy).
choices.textEn: Take a summer hustle to save for Grade 12 (+₱450, -Energy).

journal.title: Tapos na ang Grade 11!
journal.summary: Nalampasan mo ang unang taon ng SHS at nag-ipon para sa Grade 12.
journal.summaryEn: Survived your first year of SHS and saved up for Grade 12.

choices.text: Magpahinga at mag-advance reading para sa CETs (+Energy, +Mental, +GWA).
choices.textEn: Rest up and advance-read for college entrance exams.

journal.title: Tapos na ang Grade 11!
journal.summary: Nagpahinga ka at nag-review para sa paparating na College Entrance Tests.
journal.summaryEn: Recharged and prepared early for upcoming College Entrance Tests.

lines.speaker: Bea
lines.text: STEM life! Naghahanap si Ma'am ng tutulong mag-tutor sa Grade 9 Algebra tuwing Biyernes. May ₱220 honorarium per session daw!
lines.textEn: STEM perks! Ma'am is looking for someone to tutor Grade 9 Algebra on Fridays. Pays a ₱220 honorarium!

choices.text: Kunin ang tutoring slot! (Play Tutoring Quiz)
choices.textEn: Take the tutoring slot! (Play Tutoring Quiz)

choices.text: Ibigay na lang kay Bea — busy ako sa lab report.
choices.textEn: Pass it to Bea — swamped with lab reports.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: {name}, ABM ka 'di ba? Gulong-gulo na 'yung listahan ko ng utang at benta sa sari-sari store! Pwede mo bang i-ledger at i-Excel? Babayaran kita!
lines.textEn: {name}, you are in ABM right? My sari-sari store credit ledger is a total mess! Could you organize it in a spreadsheet? I will pay you!

choices.text: Sige po, Aling Nena! Ayusin ko ang cashflow niyo! (Play Freelance Task)
choices.textEn: Sure Aling Nena! I will clean up your cashflow! (Play Freelance Task)

choices.text: Turuan ko na lang po kayo nang libre gamit ang notebook.
choices.textEn: Teach her a simple notebook system for free.

lines.speaker: Kuya Jun (ComShop Owner)
lines.text: Uy, TVL-ICT! Nasira tatlong PC sa shop ko bago mag-Valorant tournament. Kaya mo bang i-reformat at ayusin ang LAN? ₱400 cash agad!
lines.textEn: Hey, TVL-ICT! Three PCs crashed at my shop right before a tournament. Can you troubleshoot and fix the LAN? ₱400 cash right away!

choices.text: Akin na screwdriver at USB! (Play Freelance Task)
choices.textEn: Hand me the screwdriver and bootable USB! (Play Freelance Task)

choices.text: Bigyan ko muna ng quick diagnosis (+₱150, tipid energy).
choices.textEn: Give a quick diagnosis only (+₱150, saves energy).

lines.speaker: Carlo
lines.text: HUMSS represent! May inter-school essay at debate contest sa bayan — ₱500 cash prize at certificate para sa college scholarship application!
lines.textEn: HUMSS represent! There is a municipal essay and debate contest — ₱500 cash prize plus a certificate that boosts college scholarship apps!

choices.text: Sumali at ipanalo ang school! (-Energy, +₱400, +GWA)
choices.textEn: Join and represent the school! (-Energy, +₱400, +GWA)

choices.text: Mag-research support na lang para kay Carlo.
choices.textEn: Help Carlo as his debate researcher.

lines.speaker: Aling Nena
lines.text: TVL-HE ka pala! Ang sarap nung graham balls at baked mac na ginawa niyo sa Cookery! Gusto mo bang i-display dito sa canteen at hati tayo sa kita?
lines.textEn: You are in TVL-HE! Those graham balls and baked mac from Cookery were amazing! Want to sell them at my counter and split the profits?

choices.text: Yes po! Simulan natin ang food hustle! (Play Tusok-Tusok)
choices.textEn: Yes! Let us launch the food hustle! (Play Street Snacks)

choices.text: Mag-part-time na lang muna sa kusina niyo (+₱280).
choices.textEn: Just take a paid kitchen prep shift (+₱280).

lines.speaker: Prof. Reyes
lines.text: Sa GAS, ang lakas ninyo ay versatility. Huwag magpadala sa nagsasabing 'GAS lang' — maraming nagiging Topnotcher at entrepreneur galing dito.
lines.textEn: In GAS, versatility is your superpower. Ignore anyone belittling it — plenty of board topnotchers and founders start here.

choices.text: Salamat Sir! Gagamitin ko 'yan para ihanda ang {course} path ko.
choices.textEn: Thank you Sir! I will use it to prepare for {course}.
